Subject: NovaPay MAP & Q2 evaluation timeline — sponsor introductions

Hi Daniel / Maya / NovaPay team,

Thanks again for the conversation last week — excited to get the MAP established so we can run a focused Q2 evaluation and align on a path to production. I’m kicking off the mutual action plan (MAP) thread and attaching a first-pass draft (NovaPay_MAP_Draft_v0.9.pdf) that captures proposed milestones, evaluation criteria, and a suggested close timeline.

High-level ask for this thread: please confirm your executive sponsor and escalation contact so we can finalize the MAP governance section. Suggested roles from our side are below.

Suggested MAP outline (short):
- Week 0: Kickoff & stakeholder roster (this thread)
- Week 1–3: Evaluation sprints (latency/cost/quality tests, integration smoke tests)
- Week 4: Executive review & go/no-go
- Week 5: Contract finalization / procurement signoff

Redwood stakeholders (cc’d):
- Sean Gallagher — Exec sponsor (SVP, Partnerships)
- Rishi Malhotra — Deal lead (AE)
- Marissa Cole — CSM / onboarding lead

Questions for you to confirm in reply:
1) Who will be NovaPay’s executive sponsor for this engagement (VP/CTO-level)?
2) Who should be the formal escalation contact if we hit an SLO/security/contract blocker?
3) Any mandatory procurement windows or PO processes we should account for?

Proposed timeline: kickoff this week, evaluation sprint starting next Monday (Jan 11), exec review Jan 29, target close by Feb 5. If dates don’t work, tell us what does.

I’ve attached the draft MAP and a short agenda for a 30-minute kickoff. If helpful I can also set a weekly 30m MAP sync.

Thanks — looking forward to getting everyone aligned.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0193

Subject: Re: NovaPay MAP & Q2 evaluation timeline — sponsor introductions

Lauren — thanks for the clear plan and the draft MAP. Happy to be brief: I’ll be the executive sponsor on the CTO side and will also ensure Sanjay Patel (VP Engineering) is the day-to-day technical sponsor for the evaluation.

Escalation path on our side: primary is me (CTO). If I’m out, route to Sanjay (vp eng). Procurement will be handled by procurement@novapay.com (cc’d). Our legal team will review the SOW but procurement typically needs a final SOW + price to start the PO process — we aim for a one-week turnaround if the SOW is in final form.

Two asks from us to help the sprint run smoothly:
- Can Redwood provide an SSO/SCIM integration checklist and any recommended network egress rules?
- If you have a short test harness or sample dataset we can run on our staging infra, that would accelerate the perf comparisons.

Accepting the proposed timeline tentatively; Jan 11 sprint start works for engineering. Please mark Sanjay (sanjay.patel@novapay.com) and me as technical leads.

Thanks — Daniel
Daniel Park
Chief Technology Officer | NovaPay
daniel.park@novapay.com

Hi Lauren / Rishi,

Thanks for the MAP. Procurement here — to keep things moving we need:
1) Final SOW with deliverables and acceptance criteria (we can use the MAP milestones as an annex)
2) Line-item pricing for the pilot and the projected monthly run-rate if we move to dedicated capacity

Procurement contact (for Docs): procurement@novapay.com
